caption:
Undoing a discount? Don't add it back.

After 15% off, the price is 85% of the original. Divide by 0.85.

Save this for test day.
tiktok_caption: Undoing a discount? Don't add it back. Divide by 0.85, don't multiply by 1.15.

youtube.title: SAT Reverse Percent Trap: Find the Original Price
youtube.description: The discount came off the original price, so divide by the multiplier. SAT-style practice question (original).
